references.text: Lists Levi's sons Gershon, Kohath and Merari, as well as their descendants, directly parallel to Genesis 46:11.
Mentions Gershon, Kohath and Merari as Levi's sons, which is directly parallel to Genesis 46:11.
Gershon, Kohath and Merari are mentioned as Levi's sons, an important parallel in the genealogies of Chronicles.
Levi is born as one of Jacob's sons, establishing the background for Levi's family as mentioned in Genesis 46:11.
Direct confirmation of the patriarchal structure of the Levite tribe in two different historical contexts.
Establishment of the three Levitical branches as a basis for later tribal overviews.
Connects the genealogy directly to the lifetime of the patriarch to confirm historical continuity.
Shows the transition from patriarchal structure to administrative temple service under David.
Expands the list to include the three Levitical clans as ethnic groups.
